summary: CBL International Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Share Sale and Purchase Agreement dated April 22, 2026, under which its subsidiary Banle Investment Holdings Limited acquires a 50.5% stake (25,250 out of 50,000 ordinary shares) in Green Marine Energy Holdings Ltd from Financent (HK) Ltd for USD 50,000 total purchase consideration. The filing states that the agreement becomes binding only upon fulfillment of conditions precedent, at which point the first instalment is paid and completion occurs concurrently. No per-share price, premium, or advisor is mentioned. This is a bolt-on acquisition giving CBL a majority stake in a sustainable fuel logistics provider in line with its energy transition strategy. Watch for fulfilment of the unspecified conditions precedent and subsequent regulatory disclosures.
